feature.title: Brain tumour segmentation, in images
feature.summary: MPB-UNet compares predicted tumour boundaries with reference masks on brain MRI. Explore the method and test examples published by Fatma Chahbar, Medjeded Merati and Saïd Mahmoudi.
feature.image_alt: Published comparison of six MRI test examples: input images, reference tumour masks and predictions by UNet variants, including MPB-UNet.
feature.image_changes: The complete figure is resized and encoded losslessly as WebP for responsive previews. No cropping or content changes. The original full-resolution PNG remains available through View full figure.

articles.title: Managing farm parcels through WALLeSmart
articles.summary: Mon Parcellaire, developed by CRA-W, brings map-based parcel creation and monitoring to WALLeSmart. The platform article explains the tool and how parcel information can be shared with connected applications.

articles.title: Alzheimer’s research across disciplines
articles.summary: UMONS presents its work on Alzheimer’s, including AI4Brain and Saïd Mahmoudi’s contribution to data analysis and modelling alongside neuroscience and clinical partners.
